note: Har bir engagement professional pentest hisoboti bilan hujjatlashtirilgan: qayta takrorlash qadamlari, MITRE ATT&CK bog'lanishi va remediation tavsiyalari.

engagements.summary: Production muhitidagi mahsulotlar ustidan tashqi penetration testing va QA. 10+ real loyiha PTES / OWASP WSTG bo'yicha test qilindi; topilmalar orasida CVSS 9.8 darajali, autentifikatsiyasiz to'liq platforma egallash zanjirlari bor. Mijoz nomlari va nishon manzillari oshkor qilinmaydi.

areas.title: Production pentest (10+ loyiha)
areas.detail: Black-box → authenticated tashqi testlar PTES va OWASP WSTG bosqichlari bo'yicha: recon, enumeration, exploitation, post-exploitation. Har bir engagement yozma ruxsat, ROE va vaqt muhrli qaydlar bilan olib borildi.

areas.title: SaaS platformasi + AWS EC2 auditi
areas.detail: 3 Critical (CVSS 9.1–9.8), 4 Medium va 6 Info topilma. Autentifikatsiyasiz to'liq egallash zanjiri jonli isbotlandi: catch-all route orqali manba kod va .env oshkorligi → JWT imzo kalitini tiklash → SuperAdmin token yasash → himoyalangan admin endpointlariga kirish. Shuningdek butun ma'lumotlar bazasini auth'siz yuklab olish, qayta ishlatilgan JWT sekreti va jonli API kalitlari oshkorligi aniqlandi.

areas.title: Ta'lim / qabul platformasi
areas.detail: OTP tasdiqlashni chetlab o'tish orqali account takeover (CVSS 9.8) — faqat telefon raqami bilan istalgan akkaunt egallanardi. Qo'shimcha: doimiy kirish beruvchi token sizishi, shaxsni tasdiqlovchi hujjatlarga nazoratsiz kirish, parol xeshlarining oshkorligi va user enumeration.

areas.title: Negative results va hisobot
areas.detail: SQLi, IDOR, path traversal/LFI, SSRF, JWT alg-confusion, command injection va file-upload → RCE tizimli sinalib rad etildi hamda hisobotda negative results sifatida hujjatlashtirildi. Har bir engagement CVSS 3.1 bahosi, executive summary, attack walkthrough, proof of access, tuzatish rejasi va cleanup statement bilan yakunlanib, retest o'tkazildi.

areas.title: QA / sifat nazorati
areas.detail: 20+ yirik veb-sayt va admin dashboard uchun funksional, regression va UI testlash; 90+ reliz ishga tushirishdan oldin test qilinib tasdiqlandi. Test-case'lar tuzildi, QA jarayoniga xavfsizlik tekshiruvi (input validation, authorization, session management) qo'shildi.

engagements.summary: HackTheBox, TryHackMe va VulNyx platformalarida 20+ mashinada to'liq qamrovli penetration test. Har bir engagement threat intelligence konteksti, MITRE ATT&CK bog'lanishi, risk baholash va remediation tavsiyalari bilan professional hisobotga aylantirilgan.

areas.title: To'liq qamrovli penetration test
areas.detail: 20+ CTF mashinasida Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Gobuster, Hydra va LinPEAS bilan boshdan oxirigacha test; har bir engagement uchun alohida professional hisobot.

areas.title: Exploit qilingan zaiflik sinflari
areas.detail: Memcached credential leakage, file upload bypass, Python module hijacking, LFI + log poisoning, KeePass database cracking va GTFOBins SUID/sudo privilege escalation — jami 6 xil sinf.

areas.title: Avtomatlashtirish (Python / Bash)
areas.detail: Wordlist generatsiyasi, service fingerprinting va exploit zanjirini avtomatlashtiruvchi skriptlar — qo'lda enumeration vaqtini ~4 soatdan 90 daqiqagacha qisqartirdi.

areas.title: Metodika va hisobot
areas.detail: Har bir assessment OWASP Top 10 va Cyber Kill Chain asosida tuzilgan; attacker TTP'lari MITRE ATT&CK texnikalariga bog'lanib, hisobot real threat actor konteksti va risk reytingi bilan boyitilgan.

engagements.summary: Tarmoq xavfsizligi, penetration testing, web ilovalar xavfsizligi, SIEM, Active Directory va incident response yo'nalishlari bo'yicha amaliy dastur.

areas.title: Tarmoq va host xavfsizligi
areas.detail: Tarmoq xavfsizligi asoslari, Active Directory muhitini tekshirish va hostlarni qattiqlashtirish.

areas.title: Web ilovalar xavfsizligi
areas.detail: Web ilovalardagi asosiy zaiflik sinflari va ularni qo'lda tekshirish metodikasi.

areas.title: SIEM va incident response
areas.detail: Hodisalarni aniqlash, tahlil qilish va javob berish jarayonlari.

areas.title: Skripting
areas.detail: Python va Bash yordamida xavfsizlik vazifalarini avtomatlashtirish.

heading: Offensive security — ish joyida va mustaqil.
description: ASOS IT'dagi production engagement'lar va mustaqil tadqiqot — metodika ham, natija ham hujjatlashtirilgan.
